svg.title: How the Vision Pro teleoperation works
svg.desc: Diagram: Vision Pro hand tracking is streamed over CloudXR to Isaac Sim, retargeted to joint targets for 7 robot hands, and the rendered view is streamed back. My additions: in-headset panel, one-click launcher, 6 imported hands, episode loop, dataset of 357 demos, review and conversion.
